spec.title: Alloy agents
spec.description: A step down is an agent that went silent; a decommissioned one leaves the same trace.

spec.title: Samples per scrape
spec.description:
Samples each job contributes on every scrape, after relabeling — what counts against the backend's active-series limit.
- Each target counts its latest reading within 30 m.

spec.title: Remote write by agent
spec.description:
Totals over the visible range.

- `Sent` / `Failed` — samples the agent delivered, and gave up on.
- `Failed %` — failed over everything it tried to send.
- `Peak lag` — highest gap reached, sampled every minute; one scrape interval of it is the healthy steady state.
- `Backlogged` — time spent more than 2 min behind.

spec.expr:
sum by (instance) (increase(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_failed_total{job=~"integrations/(self|alloy)", instance=~"$agent"}[$__range]))
/ (
  sum by (instance) (increase(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_failed_total{job=~"integrations/(self|alloy)", instance=~"$agent"}[$__range]))
  + sum by (instance) (increase(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_total{job=~"integrations/(self|alloy)", instance=~"$agent"}[$__range]))
  > 0
)

spec.title: Sample throughput
spec.description: Fleet totals, with the failure modes on the right axis. Sustained `retried` is the state that precedes loss: the endpoint is rejecting or timing out and Alloy is holding samples in the WAL.

spec.title: Shards
spec.description:
Parallel senders per agent, against the queue's `max_shards` of 50 unless the config raises it.
- Desired, on its own axis, is the shard calculator's raw request: it runs to six figures when the endpoint stops accepting.

spec.title: Pending samples
spec.description: Samples queued in the shards awaiting send; a queue that never drains is lag one step earlier. Enqueue retries on the right axis are earlier still: the shards were full and the WAL watcher had to wait.

spec.title: Send batch duration
spec.description: One batch's round trip to the remote-write endpoint. The buckets double at every step above 250 ms, so a p99 in that range places the value within an octave.

spec.title: Write throughput
spec.description: Compressed bytes on the wire to the remote-write endpoint, samples plus metadata.

spec.title: Scrape duration
spec.description:
Slowest scrape any one target of the job reached.
- A line pinned flat is the job's targets hitting their scrape timeout.

spec.title: Samples per scrape
spec.description: What one scrape cycle across the estate produces, and so what the remote-write endpoint holds as active series. The agent selector does not narrow it.

spec.title: Targets down
spec.description: Targets down at some point in the range, longest first.

spec.expr:
label_replace(
  label_join(
    label_replace(
      label_join(
        label_replace(
          label_replace(
            sum_over_time((up == bool 0)[$__interval:1m] offset -$__interval)
            * ignoring (_sort) group_left (_sort)
            count_values without () ("_sort", 1e6 - (sum_over_time((up == bool 0)[$__range:1m] @ end()) > 0)),
            "instance", "$1", "instance", "https?://(.*)"
          ),
          "instance", "$1$2", "instance", "([^.:/]*[a-zA-Z][^.:/]*)\\.[^:/]+(.*)"
        ),
        "instance", " ", "instance", "database"
      ),
      "lport", "$1", "instance", "(?:127\\.0\\.0\\.1|localhost):([0-9]+) ?"
    ),
    "hostport", ":", "host", "lport"
  ),
  "instance", "$1", "hostport", "(.+:[0-9]+)"
)

spec.title: Entries dropped & retries
spec.description:
Lines Loki refused or Alloy gave up on.
- Retries are usually 429; a dropped line has exhausted them.
- `wal decode failure` counts WAL records the watcher could not read back: lines lost with nothing else recording it, and a record is not one line.

spec.title: Send duration by status
spec.description:
p99 of one push to Loki, by the status it came back with.
- Pushes that never got an answer are a rate on the right axis.
- A 429 series is the ingestion limit clamping.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, status_code) (rate(loki_write_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"integrations/(self|alloy)", instance=~"$agent", status_code!="-1"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: CPU
spec.description:
CPU time as a share of one core: 250% is 2.5 cores.
- `max` is the highest agent at each point, `mean` the average across agents.
- A different agent can hold `max` from one point to the next, so the line is not one agent's history.

spec.title: Memory
spec.description:
`max` is the highest agent at each point, `mean` the average across agents.
- A different agent can hold `max` from one point to the next, so the line is not one agent's history.
- A max that climbs while the mean stays flat puts the leak on one agent; the table on this tab names it.

spec.title: Unhealthy components
spec.description: Components reporting anything other than `healthy`. An exited component has stopped and will not restart on its own. No data means Alloy stopped reporting, which zero does not.

spec.title: Goroutines
spec.description: Growth here runs ahead of memory growth: a scrape that never completes leaves a goroutine behind.

One row per agent.

- `CPU` — averaged over the visible range.
- `Memory`, `Goroutines`, `Version` — the latest reading.
- `Restarts` — process starts within the range; a restart resets memory and goroutines but not config age.
- `Config age` — time since that agent last accepted a config, so an agent a config rollout missed sits above the rest.

spec.title: Evaluation queue size
spec.description: Components waiting for an evaluation worker.

spec.title: Entries sent
spec.description: Log lines Loki accepted; `Logs · Log delivery by agent` has the per-agent totals.

spec.title: Version rollout
spec.description: Agents reporting each version, stacked to the fleet total. A band only moves when an agent is upgraded, so flat is the normal state.

spec.title: Scrape duration
spec.description:
Slowest scrape each target reached.
- A line pinned flat is the target hitting its scrape timeout.
- Targets with a `database` label carry it after the address; narrow the job selector before reading one out of the legend.

spec.title: Targets up
spec.description: Scrape targets across the estate as of the last scrape. The agent selector does not narrow it.

spec.title: Samples per scrape
spec.description:
Samples each target contributes on every scrape, after relabeling, from its latest reading within 30 m.
- Narrow the job selector before reading a target out of the legend.

spec.title: Throughput
spec.description: What the fleet ships, as accepted by each endpoint. Log lines are on the right axis.

spec.title: Log delivery by agent
spec.description:
Totals over the visible range.

- `Sent` / `Dropped` — entries Loki accepted, and entries the agent gave up on.
- `Dropped %` — dropped over everything it tried to send.
- `Retries` — batches resent, usually after a 429.
- `Mean delay` — from an entry's own timestamp to Loki accepting it.

spec.expr:
sum by (instance) (increase(loki_write_dropped_entries_total{job=~"integrations/(self|alloy)", instance=~"$agent"}[$__range]))
/ (
  sum by (instance) (increase(loki_write_dropped_entries_total{job=~"integrations/(self|alloy)", instance=~"$agent"}[$__range]))
  + sum by (instance) (increase(loki_write_sent_entries_total{job=~"integrations/(self|alloy)", instance=~"$agent"}[$__range]))
  > 0
)

sum by (instance) (increase(loki_write_entry_propagation_latency_seconds_sum{job=~"integrations/(self|alloy)", instance=~"$agent"}[$__range]))
/ (
  sum by (instance) (increase(loki_write_entry_propagation_latency_seconds_count{job=~"integrations/(self|alloy)", instance=~"$agent"}[$__range]))
  > 0
)

spec.title: Config load failed
spec.description: An agent whose load failed keeps serving the config it loaded last, so its components stay healthy and no other panel moves.

spec.title: Agents behind
spec.description: Agents more than 2 min behind; the number is the latest scrape.

spec.title: Remote-write lag
spec.description:
Gap between the newest sample an agent has buffered and the newest one the endpoint has acknowledged.
- The sawtooth is the scrape cycle: every agent climbs to one interval and drops back on the next flush.
- The line is the 2 min mark `Overview · Agents behind` counts from.
- A climb that does not come back is the endpoint refusing or throttling writes.

spec.title: Delivery failures
spec.description: Samples and log lines the pipeline gave up on or had to repeat.
